observations: body L1-L7: the end of the sentence begun on p. 326. «Buṭrus al–Bustānī» is letter-spaced, with a long dash (5.2 pt); «Arabico–Persicos» and «Arabico–Africanos» have long dashes (about 5.5 pt, joined to the letters). The hyphens of «opera-» and «abhor-» measure 2.2 and 2.3 pt. A speck under the d of «dicendi» (L3) is not transcribed.

body L8-L11: the head is set in capitals and small capitals; the dash after «a)» measures 10.0 pt, that of «24–30» 5.3 pt. Appendix H is p. 150, L24-L30 of the translation, by the count of that page, which runs through the heads. «Schiaparelli» is letter-spaced. The places are p. 322 (L21-L23 there: appendix H foretold in chapter XLII) and Schiaparelli's note a on chapter XLII, p. 273.

notes_left L1-L2, notes_right L1-L2: note 1 runs from the left column into the right. «Suter», «al–Ḥaṣṣār», «al-Qalaṣādī» and «Ibn al-Bannā’» are letter-spaced; the dash of «al–Ḥaṣṣār» measures 4.3 pt and is set as a long dash, the hyphens of «al-Qalaṣādī» and «al-Bannā’» 3.8 and 2.8 pt. Suter's article is that cited on p. 326, note 2. The 1 of «cap. 1» prints broken.

body: a tailpiece closes Part I below the notes: a thin rule (138.7 pt long, 0.48 pt thick) with knobs and lenses in the middle. The ornament is traced from the print; the rule, printed broken to the right of the ornament, is drawn whole between the ends of its ink (figures/AB01-PDF0416-F01.tex).
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
